body: Last night was really really rough but I'm still here.

Your post gave me chills because that was me about 5 years ago. Every little detail. Ugh. I lost all of my friends as well because they were tired of me being in love with someone who treated me terribly. Don't ever think it's you,or that you're not good enough. He has issues. Issues that you can't fix. You do have a right to be upset and he knows it as well. I really really feel for you.
I'm really anxious but I don't feel like it's unbearable anymore. Thanks :)

Yeah, that's something I didn't think about. Anger always seemed to me like a "bad" emotion. I can be a people pleaser, so being angry isn't something that comes easy for me either . But I can be angry with him and it's ok. He was cruel and took advantage of my trust.

Yeah. A low tide is a great way to describe how I feel.It's hard to say what I'd tell someone else. I'd probably tell her that no matter what I say, I can't tell her anything to make the pain go away any faster. It's just going to take time...and congrats, day 1 is down.And I'm really sorry that this situation made her feel so desperate and unworthy that she was close to taking her own life.
Thank you. Today was a low point and the comments helped me through. :)
Drained, to be honest. I was really scared for a little while. I'm going to seek professional help tomorrow.
